findings.title: RuntimeApiUrl not recorded to the consolidated env in the frontend phase
findings.detail: phase_frontend reads RUNTIME_API_URL from the rtapi outputs file to drive the build but never calls record_output RuntimeApiUrl; only phase_runtime_api records it. After a full --phase all run the consolidated /tmp/mahalo-outputs.env is complete (runtime-api ran first), but a standalone --phase frontend run truncates the consolidated env at dispatch and would omit RuntimeApiUrl from it. Cosmetic only; the value is still in /tmp/mahalo-rtapi-outputs.json and the build uses it correctly. Optional: add record_output RuntimeApiUrl in the frontend phase for symmetry.
